title: Ali imam e man asto manam ghulam e ali
body:
Ali imam e man asto manam ghulam e ali
Ali ali ali ali ali..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai kayenaat me..(2)
tauheed ki jo shamma jali
<<DIVIDER>>
Usi ke noor ka..(2)
jalwa hai mustafa o ali
<<DIVIDER>>
Ali imam e man asto manam ghulam e ali..(2)
1. Karam khuda ka hua hogaye wo shere khuda
<<DIVIDER>>
bahaduri me koi hai kahan ali jaisa..(2)
hasan husain ke baba..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
wo janesaar e nabi
2. Mila jo hukm e ilahi buto'n ko tha dhaya
<<DIVIDER>>
khuda ne taaje wilayat inhi ko pehnaya..(2)
ali ka ghar hai jahan..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
aale mustafa hai pali
3. Hua ishara e haider gira dare khaibar
<<DIVIDER>>
shikare teghe ali the jo marhabo antar..(2)
misaale balk wo..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
maidaa'n me zulfiqar chali
4. Ali wali hai mujahid hai shere yazdaa'n hai
<<DIVIDER>>
huzoor ne ye kaha tha wo kulle eemaa'n hai..(2)
haq unke saath hamesha..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
aur uske saath ali
5. Kisi ne martaba e buturaab kab jaana
<<DIVIDER>>
faqat khuda o nabi ne ali ko pehchana..(2)
jo puchna hai to pucho..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
inhi se kya hai ali
6. Na dusra hai ali aur na koi aisa jari
<<DIVIDER>>
na aasmaan ne dekha zamee pe aisa sakhi..(2)
na khali haath gaya..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
koi jiske darr se kabhi
7. Khitaab ho ke bayaa hai wo marefat ka nisha
<<DIVIDER>>
ali ki danish o hikmat hai faislo se ayaa..(2)
hai lazawal riwayat..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
jaha'n me adl e ali
8. Agar kahi koi banda ho mushkilo me ghira
<<DIVIDER>>
madad ko aate hai maula ali ba hukm e khuda..(2)
abhi jo koi pukare..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
madad ko aaye abhi
9. Khuda hai maula to 'safdar' hai mustafa maula
<<DIVIDER>>
nabi ne khum me kaha tha ke hai ali maula..(2)
nabi hai jiske bhi maula..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
kamaal usike ali
Ali imam e man asto manam ghulam e ali..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Ali ali ali ali ali..(2)
author: Ali Safdar
